text:
mira_sales: Heads-up — Greenleaf Financial (CISO+Procurement) escalated. They want a 2-week private POC (VPC) and want answers to pricing cap, KMS/HSM integration, and data residency before signing. They said timeline is tight and will pause if we can't commit.

infra_ops_bot: Created ticket #INF-8742 for VPC onboarding request. Assigned to eng-infra.

linda_sales_lead: Can you paste the exact asks from their CISO? Do we have the full security questionnaire or just bullet items?

mira_sales: Copied verbatim from email: "1) All inference logs must remain in EU region (Frankfurt). 2) KMS-managed keys or HSM for key wrapping. 3) No raw customer PII stored outside their VPC. 4) SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning. 5) Pilot pricing cap: $X/day or 40% off list for 3 months."

aj_se: Quick tech notes — for a 2-week private POC with EU residency we should provision a Dedicated pool in eu-central and enable VPC peering. KMS/HSM: Redwood Private supports KMS integrations (customer-managed AWS KMS) and we can also support HSM via partner channel but that adds ops lead time (~5 business days).

aj_se: Also need expected qps/seq-len so we can size GPUs + KV cache config. Do we have target concurrent sessions?

mira_sales: Customer expects 200 qps peak with 4s avg latency SLA (they said latency is critical). I'll ask them to confirm exact sequence lengths.

tom_legal: For KMS/HSM and data residency, legal needs to see: data flow diagram (what leaves customer VPC, logs retention policy), and the indemnity/processing language they require. If they insist on HSM, we need procurement approval for the HSM partner. Also set expectations: HSM onboarding may change timeline and cost.

natalie_cust_success: On SSO/SCIM — we can support SAML and SCIM, but there are a couple of steps: metadata exchange, service account provisioning, and test users. That usually takes 3-5 business days once we have their IdP config.

linda_sales_lead: Pricing ask: they requested 40% off list for 3 months — does finance allow pilot discounts that deep? We should propose an alternative: credits + reduced commit.

aj_se: Proposed commercial workaround: 25% pilot discount + $10k implementation credit for HSM/KMS integration and priority onboarding (SLA-backed). Tie full discount/commit to agreed SLAs and success criteria.

mira_sales: They pushed on the 40% number in the email and said it's a gating item for exec signoff. Any chance we can offer a one-time concession?

tom_legal: If we offer >30% discount or credits that change billing terms significantly, legal/finance need to approve revised MSA terms. Please capture exact concession and I will fast-track review but need a PO or signed LOI.

linda_sales_lead: I'll ping finance now. @aj_se please draft a short one-pager with proposed scope, metrics for success (qps, latency), and the commercial terms (25% + $10k credit). Put HSM as optional add-on with separate SOW.

aj_se: Will do — drafting now. Sharing checklist for security questions we need to complete for legal and infra:

```
- Data flows (ingress, egress, logs)
- Storage residency confirmation and retention windows
- KMS/HSM details and key access model
- SSO/SAML metadata and SCIM endpoints
- Incident response and access logs availability
- Required compliance reports (SOC2, ISO)
```

mira_sales: Thanks. I'll consolidate their email and schedule a call with CISO + our eng/infra + legal tomorrow 09:00 CET. Can everyone confirm availability? :calendar:

natalie_cust_success: I can make it.

aj_se: Available — will bring sizing notes and draft SOW.

tom_legal: Available for first 30 min to cover contract/high-risk items.

linda_sales_lead: I'll join. Also finance said they'll respond within 24 hours on concession bands.

infra_ops_bot: INF-8742 updated: assigned to @eng-infra (lead: carlos_infra). ETA for VPC provisioning: 2 business days after approvals. HSM onboarding ETA: 5–7 business days after partner procurement.

mira_sales: Great — summary action items: 1) aj_se: one-pager + SOW draft; 2) me: confirm qps/seq with customer + schedule call; 3) tom_legal: fast-track review pending LOI; 4) infra: start VPC prep (INF-8742). We'll reconvene after call.

linda_sales_lead: Thanks all. High priority — label as exec-escalation in CRM. :triangular_flag_on_post:

mira_sales: Thanks — closing loop here.
